name: 00-sample-opposition
source: Invented sample. Real opposition material is not published.

speeches.label: 1st Opposition
speeches.text: Good evening. The proposition must prove replacement, not assistance. Presales is judgement under uncertainty, not a list of deliverables. AI can generate an answer; it cannot own a wrong one. Teams may become leaner, but change is not replacement.

speeches.label: 2nd Opposition
speeches.text: Their case fails three tests: substitution, scale and accountability. Calculators are more accurate than people, yet humans still own the decision. Self-service changes where presales enters the journey; it does not remove the need.

speeches.label: Opposition Summary
speeches.text: They proved can, may and some. The motion requires will, replace and us. AI will transform us. It will not replace us.
